name: m5-zd-control
description: Control for the zinc-direct lab: only the Scala differs (Zinc 1.12.1, one compile of Pekko 1.7.1's `stream`, profiled with kperf cycles/instructions). [scala/scala#11367](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11367) should show as the itable stub share of cycles falling (10.5% to 1.3% in the PR's measurement, where `@specialized` makes a third analyzer class) and a lower time per compile. If it does not, the harness or this corpus cannot see it.

variantDescriptions.tip: Zinc 1.12.1, Scala at the tip (6101d22), which has [scala/scala#11367](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11367): the typechecker's calls to its analyzer are invokevirtual, not invokeinterface
